# PulseCut Local AI — In-Browser Video to Shorts Studio

> PulseCut Local AI is a 100% in-browser, privacy-first AI video clipping and editing studio. It converts long horizontal videos into 60 FPS platform-ready vertical Shorts, TikToks, and Reels with zero cloud processing, zero server uploads, and zero API keys required.

## Core Capabilities
- **Local AI Clipping**: Split and reframe videos entirely on the client device using browser-native technologies.
- **Hardware WebCodecs**: Real-time 60 FPS hardware-accelerated video rendering via GPU encoders (H.264/AVC).
- **Kinetic Subtitles**: Word-level highlight captions with custom themes calibrated within platform safe zones.
- **AI Smart Reframing**: Intelligent face focus, speaker tracking, and cinematic 9:16 aspect ratio transforms.
- **Platform Presets**: Calibrated dimensions, bitrates, and safe-zones for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, X Clips, Threads, and LinkedIn Video.

## Key Studio Pages & Architecture
- [Studio](/studio): The full in-browser timeline editor, live preview canvas, and WebCodecs export engine.
- [Features](/features): Deep technical breakdown of client-side video processing, privacy architecture, and supported codecs.
- [Video to Shorts](/video-to-shorts): Quick conversion guide and workflow for repurposing long-form content.
- [Smart Reframe](/smart-reframe): AI face and motion-tracking reframing details.
- [Platforms](/platforms): Platform specifications, aspect ratios, and safe-zone rules.
- [Privacy Manifesto](/privacy): Complete zero-upload, zero-retention privacy documentation.

## Privacy & Security Guarantees
- Videos are processed locally using WebCodecs and Web Audio API.
- No user footage, audio, or metadata ever leaves the browser tab.
- Operates offline or in air-gapped environments once loaded.
